notes.title: Release 1.0.0.47 - Campaign Choices
notes.notes:
Gameplay Changes

[list]
[*] It is now possible to unlock all campaigns and Endless Mode based on progress, even if you haven't beaten all campaigns
[*] Once unlocked you can choose which campaign to play when creating a new profile or after a run
[*] You can also Abandon Settlement on a profile and then choose a different 
campaign
[/list]

notes.title: Release v1.0.0.46
notes.notes:
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gone Fishing Mode now begins with more bait and cards that will allow you to terraform land (create swamps, bayous) so that you can get worms and leeches for fishing
[*] Two Additional Game Options can be set on new civilizations/profiles:
[list][*] Eels - Enable/Disable enemies that spawn in lakes/rivers
[*] Champions - Enable/Disable Champion enemies
[*] The original Three Against the Odds Mode does not allow changing these options
[/list]
[*] You now gain much more experience from killing Champions 


[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.0.0.45 - Of Modes and Monsters
notes.notes:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
The Game now has Three Distinct Modes that can be chosen when starting a new civilization:
[list]

[*]Three Against the Odds (the original game where enemies spawn throughout day and night with some rest periods)[list]
[*]Total standard monsters which used to begin at 2 now starts at 1 in this mode and increases slightly less as you level up
[/list]
[*]Three Against the Night - Standard Enemies only spawn at night although they can survive into the day if not killed.
[list]
[*]Total standard monsters starts at 2 in this mode and increases slightly more as you level up
[/list]
[*]Gone Fishing - A Sandbox mode where no standard enemies spawn.  There is no campaign associated with this mode.
[/list]

You may now sell/cancel construction sites to regain the wood/stone that they cost

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]The new game modes now display in your civilization
[*]Campaigns also display in your civilization when starting
[*]Some minor changes to how buttons appear in the game
[/list]

notes.title: Release v1.0.0.44
notes.notes:
Bugfixes
[list]
[*]Ruins that did not have a reward crashed the game upon destruction
[*]Fixed issue with upgrading Charm ability to level 4
[*]If you were a Canopog at Level 4 (2 movepoints per turn) and had Assassin's Sanctuary the Sanctuary did not move properly with you until all move points expired.  This is now changed so that it moves on each move and leaves a trail behind
[/list]
